_what: Every card carries a description. `check`: the card's words check fails with no description (cards.py). `fill`: the filer fills an empty description with the line most of the brand's live cards carry, the same product's first, never a price, an offer or a dated line (to_check.py live_description).
_rollback: "on": false turns both off (a card files and passes with no description, as before); "check": false or "fill": false turns one off. One machine only: META_DESCRIPTION_OFF=all, or check, or fill. Row DESCRIPTION in team/rollbacks.md.
